title: Chhathi Maiya ka Chamatkar
style: hyper-real cinematic devotional film still, warm golden sunset light, deep saturated colours, dramatic rim light, intricate detail, respectful, no text, no letters, no writing, no watermark, no signature
hook: Chhathi Maiya ne baalak kaise jivit kiya?
source: Brahmavaivarta Purana, Prakriti Khanda, adhyay 43 (Shashthi upakhyan); Devi Bhagavata Purana 9.46. Chhath mein inhi Shashthi Devi ki pooja: lok manyata
summary: Brahmavaivarta Purana ki katha: Raja Priyavrat ka mrit putra, Devi Devasena (Shashthi) ne jivit kiya; Chhath mein Chhathi Maiya ke roop mein pooja (manyata)

scenes.prompt: Dramatic cinematic close-up portrait of Shashthi Devi as a radiant divine mother goddess with a gentle compassionate face, red and gold silk saree, golden jewellery and crown, a huge glowing setting sun like a halo behind her head, cradling a sleeping newborn wrapped in yellow cloth, river ghat with diyas softly blurred behind, the face in the lower half of the frame
scenes.tts: छठी मैया ने एक मरे हुए बालक को कैसे जीवित कर दिया?
scenes.sub: Chhathi Maiya ne ek mare hue baalak ko kaise jivit kar diya?

scenes.prompt: An ancient Indian king and queen in royal silk and gold sitting sadly together in a lamp-lit palace hall, the queen looking down with longing, warm golden evening light, cinematic wide shot
scenes.tts: ब्रह्मवैवर्त पुराण की कथा है। राजा प्रियव्रत और रानी मालिनी की कोई संतान नहीं थी।
scenes.sub: Brahmavaivarta Purana ki katha hai. Raja Priyavrat aur Rani Malini ki koi santaan nahi thi.

scenes.prompt: An old rishi with a long white beard performing a sacred yagya, tall bright fire in a square brick havan kund, the king and queen with folded hands beside it, smoke and golden sparks rising, cinematic
scenes.tts: महर्षि कश्यप ने पुत्रेष्टि यज्ञ कराया। रानी को पुत्र हुआ, पर वह जन्म से ही मृत था।
scenes.sub: Maharishi Kashyap ne putreshti yagya karaya. Rani ko putra hua, par woh janm se hi mrit tha.

scenes.prompt: A grieving ancient Indian king kneeling alone on a misty river bank at dusk, head bowed, holding a small bundle of white cloth close to his chest, dark blue sky with the last orange glow, no blood, no violence, cinematic
scenes.tts: दुखी राजा बालक को लेकर श्मशान पहुँचे, और अपने प्राण त्यागने को तैयार हो गए।
scenes.sub: Dukhi raja baalak ko lekar shmashaan pahunche, aur apne praan tyaagne ko taiyaar ho gaye.

scenes.prompt: A glowing golden celestial vimana chariot descending from the evening sky through parting clouds, radiant beams of divine light falling on a misty river bank, a tiny kneeling figure below looking up in awe, epic cinematic wide shot
scenes.tts: तभी आकाश से एक दिव्य विमान उतरा। उसमें प्रकट हुईं देवी देवसेना।
scenes.sub: Tabhi aakaash se ek divya vimaan utra. Usmein prakat huin Devi Devasena.

scenes.prompt: A radiant divine mother goddess in red and gold with a soft golden halo gently touching a newborn baby wrapped in yellow cloth held by a kneeling king, the baby glowing with warm light, flower petals floating in the air, cinematic, tender and joyful
scenes.tts: देवी बोलीं, मैं प्रकृति का छठा अंश हूँ, इसलिए मेरा नाम षष्ठी है। और बालक को छूते ही वह जीवित हो गया!
scenes.sub: Devi boleen, main Prakriti ka chhatha ansh hoon, isliye mera naam Shashthi hai. Aur baalak ko chhoote hi woh jivit ho gaya!

scenes.prompt: Women devotees in bright saris standing waist-deep in a calm river at sunset seen from behind, holding bamboo soop baskets with fruits and lit diyas up towards a huge orange setting sun, golden reflections on the water, cinematic wide shot
scenes.label: tradition
scenes.tts: राजा ने तभी से षष्ठी देवी की पूजा शुरू की। मान्यता है, छठ में इन्हीं को छठी मैया कहकर पूजते हैं।
scenes.sub: Raja ne tabhi se Shashthi Devi ki pooja shuru ki. Manyata hai, Chhath mein inhi ko Chhathi Maiya kehkar poojte hain.

scenes.prompt: A mother seen from behind holding her small child's hand on river ghat steps at dusk, rows of lit clay diyas and a bamboo soop basket beside them, warm golden reflections on the water, peaceful, cinematic
scenes.tts: सीख यही है, सच्चे मन की पुकार माँ ज़रूर सुनती है।
scenes.sub: Seekh yahi hai, sachche mann ki pukaar Maa zaroor sunti hai.

scenes.tts: छठी मैया सबकी मनोकामना पूरी करें! कमेंट में लिखें जय छठी मैया, और लाइक, शेयर, सब्सक्राइब करें।
scenes.sub: Chhathi Maiya sabki manokamna poori karein! Comment mein likhein Jai Chhathi Maiya, aur Like, Share, Subscribe karein.

facts.claim: King Priyavrat (son of Svayambhuva Manu) and queen Malini were childless; Kashyapa performed a putreshti yajna; the son was born dead
facts.source: Brahmavaivarta Purana, Prakriti Khanda 43.8-12; Devi Bhagavata Purana 9.46

facts.claim: At the cremation ground the king was ready to give up his life; Devi Devasena appeared in a vimana, said she is Shashthi, the sixth part of Prakriti, and revived the child; the king started her worship
In Chhath this Shashthi Devi is worshipped as Chhathi Maiya (belief)
